children: Nabors published an investor presentation ahead of investor conferences highlighting 2026 outlook, rig counts, debt-reduction progress and capital plans.
Released investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) ahead of September investor meetings; includes forward-looking statements and risk disclosures.
Reiterated 3Q and full-year 2026 outlook: U.S. and international rig counts, segment adjusted margins/EBITDA and capex guidance.
Full-year 2026 outlook: $710–$730M adjusted EBITDA, $20–$30M adjusted free cash flow, $920–$930M capital expenditures.
As of 6/30/26 net debt $1,554M (cash $941M); noted gross debt reduction and partial redemption of 2030 notes completed 8/12/2026.
International expansion: targeting ~98 rigs by year-end with a Venezuela contract to start early Q1 2027 and SANAD newbuilds driving Saudi growth.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Nabors publishes investor presentation outlining 2026 outlook, rig counts, debt reduction and capital plan
